links.outcome: Head-to-head diagnostic accuracy of two competing AI DR screening products on the same cohort
links.effect: IDx-DR sensitivity 99.3%, specificity 68.9%; RetCAD sensitivity 89.4%, specificity 94.8%. PPV 48.1% vs 96.4%; NPV 99.5% vs 83.1%. Operating trade-offs differed materially between products.
links.quote: In this direct comparison using the same patient cohort, the two algorithms showed differences in their operating parameters for RDR screening.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation comparing the diagnostic performance metrics of two commercial AI screening systems (IDx-DR vs RetCAD) on retinal images from diabetic patients without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
